rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f4952 p. 1, Part I, line 2: "Disallowed investment interest expense from 2024 Form 4952, line 7". The candidate is the project's Stage 20 expression (f4952.prior_7 when f4952.carryover is Yes, zero when No) wrapped in a floor at zero, which changes no value because both branches are non-negative. Triage (1,866): 1,729 agree, no value difference; 58 project-refuses are the project's cited screens on line 2 (f4952.unsupported, f4952.alternative_allocation; witnesses 0-3) and 79 project-unknown the same screens withheld in partial records (witnesses 6-9). Checked: the carryforward is the printed 2024 line 7 and is asked only when the filer says one exists; with the old f4952.carryover refusal gone, no remaining gate on line 2 is unrelated to scope.

Ruling: representation; in the supported slice, sb.line2 is exactly sum_over(interest,interest.amount), sb.line6 copies the supplied ordinary-dividend total and f1040.line3b copies sb.line6. Replacing only those exact aliases makes the income operands identical. f4952 (2025) p.3 Line4a includes taxable interest and ordinary dividends before removing qualified dividends on4b. No inference is made about the other income classes screened by f4952.unsupported.

Ruling: scope; f4952 p. 3, Line 4a: "Gross income from property held for investment includes income, unless derived in the ordinary course of a trade or business, from interest, ordinary dividends (except Alaska Permanent Fund dividends), annuities, and royalties." Form 1040 line 2b is Schedule B line 4 (line 2 less line 3, and line 3 is zero because the savings bond exclusion is refused by sb.unsupported), so floored at zero it is Schedule B line 2; line 3b copies Schedule B line 6. Triage (1,866): 1,799 agree, no value difference; 27 candidate-refuses and 37 candidate-unknown are the candidate's f4952.unsupported refusal on line 4a (witness 1, classm.clcw.3.deepseek: project $34,100, candidate refuses), which the project applies on lines 2 and 5, the election and f4952.required; 3 project-refuses are upstream sb.unsupported and sb.line8 screens (witnesses 12-14). Alaska Permanent Fund dividends are on Schedule 1 line 8g, not Schedule B.

Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 3, Line 4d: "Net gain from the disposition of property held for investment is the excess, if any, of your total gains over your total losses from the disposition of property held for investment. When figuring this amount, include capital gain distributions from mutual funds and capital loss carryovers." The candidate is the sum of sales column (h) floored at zero, leaving out capital gain distributions and, after Stage 20, the carryovers on Schedule D lines 6 and 14. Its note says these are covered by f4952.unsupported, but that screen names interest attributable to royalties, a business, passive activities and similar items and "other investment income or expense beyond interest, dividends and securities sales", not distributions or carryovers. Triage (1,866): 1,385 agree, 293 value (79 on completed returns), 120 project-refuses, 3 project-unknown, 29 candidate-refuses, 36 candidate-unknown. Witness 4 (classm.f4952.2.deepseek, completed): project $9,316 (Schedule D line 16: sales $5,120 plus $4,196 distributions on line 13), candidate $5,120; witness 1 (classm.f8889.1.deepseek, completed): project $6,062, candidate $0.

Ruling: model error; f4952 p.3 Line4d defines net gain as total gains over total losses and expressly includes capital gain distributions and loss carryovers. Line4e separately limits net capital gain. The returned min(ScheduleD15,ScheduleD16) incorrectly excludes positive net short-term gains from line4d. With $1000 short-term gain and $500 long-term gain, line4d is $1500; the returned $500 is the separate net-capital-gain quantity. No raw or numeric model answer is replaced.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: interface gap; the reply explicitly interprets this opaque result id as the net-capital-gain share attributed to line4g, while the project export means the full line4g amount. f4952 p.4 discusses both quantities. The blind interface names only an id/type, so the target meaning is underdetermined; clarify the source-defined quantity rather than call this clean model-only tax noise. The candidate also fails expression checks and remains rejected.

Ruling: model error; f4952 p.4 Line4g says to make the election by entering the elected amount on line4g. A positive declared election therefore needs this form even if the interest-expense deduction otherwise meets the p.3 filing exception. Both returned predicates omit the positive-line4g condition. For investment interest $100, ordinary nonqualified investment income $200 and declared elected dividends $50, the exception can hold while the election still requires Form4952. The project asks whether the form is needed for the deduction or declared election; no new owner scope choice is made.

Ruling: model error; f4952 (2025) p.4 Line4g requires entering the elected amount on Form4952 to make the election. The second only tests the interest-deduction exception and carryover, omitting the election. With $20000 ordinary dividends ($10000 qualified), no investment interest and an election of $10000, the project requires the form and the second returns false. The saved evaluator witness is .transcription/f4952-election-required-witness.json. The interface explicitly asks about filing for an election as well as claiming interest.

Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don't have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply. ... You don't have any carryover of disallowed investment interest expense from 2024." and f4952 p. 4, Line 4g: "To make the election, enter on line 4g the amount you elect to include in investment income (don't enter more than the sum of lines 4b and 4e)". The candidate is true whenever line 4c is not more than line 1 or a carryforward is answered Yes, with no test that there is interest to claim, so a filer with no investment interest and no investment income must file (0 <= 0); and it never requires the form for an election alone. Triage (`../triage/f4952.deepseek.json`, 1,866): 700 agree, 919 value (389 on completed returns), 148 project-refuses, 79 project-unknown, 16 candidate-refuses, 4 candidate-unknown. Witness 0 (classm.f2441.1.deepseek, completed): lines 1, 3 and 4c $0, project false, candidate true. The refusals are cited screens (f4952.alternative_allocation, sd.other_forms; witnesses 6-9) or upstream Schedule B screens on the candidate side (sb.line8, sb.form8938; witnesses 12-16).
